description: Implementation of internal cache interface for FreeType, including cache node management, hash table resizing, and cache lifecycle functions.

methods.name: ftc_node_mru_link
methods.description: Adds a node to the head of the manager's MRU list.

methods.name: ftc_node_mru_unlink
methods.description: Removes a node from the manager's MRU list.

methods.name: ftc_node_mru_up
methods.description: Moves a node to the head of the manager's MRU list.

methods.name: ftc_get_top_node_for_hash
methods.description: Retrieves the top bucket for a given hash in the cache.

methods.name: ftc_cache_resize
methods.description: Resizes the cache's hash table to maintain load factors.

methods.name: ftc_node_hash_unlink
methods.description: Removes a node from its cache's hash table.

methods.name: ftc_node_hash_link
methods.description: Adds a node to the top of its cache's hash table.

methods.name: ftc_node_destroy
methods.description: Removes and frees a node from the cache and manager.

methods.name: FTC_Cache_Clear
methods.description: Clears all nodes from the cache.

methods.name: ftc_cache_add
methods.description: Adds a new node to the cache.

methods.name: FTC_Cache_NewNode
methods.description: Creates a new cache node, with out-of-memory handling.

methods.name: FTC_Cache_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a node in the cache, reordering MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_Cache_RemoveFaceID
methods.description: Removes nodes associated with a specific face ID.
